_comment: Offsets into the $A5-byte SRAM monster record (E-0262) that have evidence. tools/disasm_all.py writes them to src/records.inc as MON_* constants and uses them for the offset a record-access routine takes in C (E-0290). Offsets without an entry stay numeric.

00.note: state: 0 empty, 1 kept, 2 in the party (C2 from E-0320: the monster list numbers the three records in state 2 as party members 1-3 and lists the state-1 records after them unnumbered)

01.note: name, 10 bytes ending in $F0 (C2 from E-0320: the status page's monster, Kheri, is spelled at $01) (E-0323: a save and a fresh load keep the name up to its $F0 and pad the rest of the 10 bytes with $F0)

0B.note: species id word (C2 from E-0320: Patta's record holds $0073 and its status page names it Dracky, String_08_02_73, entry $73 of the monster names; talk events $29/$47 compare it with monster ids, E-0236)

0E.note: bit 0 = sex: 0 male, 1 female (C2: the egg appraiser's script chooses 'No doubt at all-it's male.' for 0 and '...female.' for 1 through wTwoChoiceCursor = this bit, EggServiceMenu_ChooseAndPay_CheckAndPay); breeding steps back when no other listed record has the other sex; DrawRecordListPageMarks draws mark tile $CC + bit 0 when MON_EGG is 2

0F.note: the master's name, 10 bytes: ComputeBreedingChild stores the player name here (CopyPlayerNameToWCADF) and copies each parent's into the child's parent master names (E-0297); called 'second name' in E-0034

19.note: the id of the player who bred it: ComputeBreedingChild stores wPlayerId here (C1)

1A.note: species word of the first parent (from its $0B; CopySixBytesByWCADDBit4Table, the order swapped by bit 4 of $0D) (C2 from E-0328: a child bred from base Vanyl (Gulpple, $92) and mate Moahm ($C2) holds $92 here and $C2 in MON_PARENT2_SPECIES)

1C.note: species word of the second parent (C2 from E-0328, see MON_PARENT1_SPECIES: the mate's species)

1E.note: master name of the first parent (from its $0F; CopyFourNamesByWCADDBit4Table)

28.note: not read by any code found; presets hold 0 and the unknown-parents placeholder writes $FF (it follows the first parent's master name)

29.note: master name of the second parent

33.note: not read by any code found; presets hold 0 and the unknown-parents placeholder writes $FF (it follows the second parent's master name)

34.note: skills, 8 bytes, $FF for an empty slot (C2 from E-0321: the pause menu's skill page lists 'Sleep' for a record holding $2F, $FF x 7; $2F is String_08_04_2F, 'Sleep', in the skill names)

3C.note: the list AppendMappedSkillsToWCA67 appends to, up to $FF; in E-0321 a Dracky record holds $21, $2F, $32 here, the three natural skills of SpeciesRecord_Dracky (C1: the skills the monster can learn)

55.note: status bits: bit 7 dead (C2 from E-0330: with bit 7 set and MON_HP 0 the priest's Revive lists the monster and, for 25G, leaves this byte 0 and MON_HP at MON_MAX_HP; by reading, InnMenu_RestoreParty skips records with bit 7 set, E-0276); bit 2 read as poison (E-0085)

56.note: level (C2 from E-0320: a monster's status page in tools/sm83.py shows Lv 25, HP 156/156, MP 89/89, ATK 84, DEF 149, AGL 115, INT 366, WLD 387 for SRAM record 0, which holds them at $56 and $5B-$6C in this order)

57.note: level cap (C1): DrawRecordLevelAndStatusRow_1E loads $56-$57 as a pair and draws the cap mark $6F when the level is at least this byte; in E-0320 the Dracky record holds 50, Dracky's species base level cap ($32)

58.note: experience, 24 bits (C2 from E-0320: the status page shows Ex 15 and 12 more for the next level for a level-4 record holding 15; ExpTable row 2 needs 15 for level 4 and 27 for level 5)

5B.note: current HP word (C2 from E-0326: lowered to 5, the stats page shows 'HP: 5/21'; a Herb raises it by 30-40 up to MON_MAX_HP)

5D.note: maximum HP word (C2 from E-0326: the second number of 'HP: 5/21' and the cap of a Herb)

5F.note: current MP word (C2 from E-0326: lowered to 7, the stats page shows 'MP: 7/35')

61.note: maximum MP word (C2 from E-0326: the second number of 'MP: 7/35')

63.note: ATK word (C2 from E-0320: a monster's status page in tools/sm83.py shows Lv 25, HP 156/156, MP 89/89, ATK 84, DEF 149, AGL 115, INT 366, WLD 387 for SRAM record 0, which holds them at $56 and $5B-$6C in this order; first of the stats column, raised by AddAToRecordWordCapped like $65-$69)

65.note: DEF word (C2 from E-0320, see MON_ATK)

67.note: AGL word (C2 from E-0320, see MON_ATK)

69.note: INT word (C2 from E-0320, see MON_ATK)

6B.note: WLD (wildness) word (C2 from E-0320, see MON_ATK): the fifth word of the stats column after ATK, DEF, AGL and INT, matching the INFO panel's order ATK, DEF, AGL, INT, WLD (E-0046)

6D.note: the breeding plus value (C1): when non-zero, the monster's info screen (WithSRAMDraw4ACEAnd4BE8_ShowStringBank08AtTilesHL_Bank03) draws glyph $FC and the value in one or two digits after the member number; BreedMenu_CopyToChildThenTalkEvent16 copies it to the child record

6E.note: egg state: 0 not an egg, 1 an egg not yet appraised (set when an egg record is created), 2 an appraised egg (EggServiceMenu_ChooseAndPay_CheckAndPay sets it after charging the 20-gold fee; only then does the record list show the sex mark); CountRecordsByField6E finding none gives 'You have no eggs.' (C2)

6F.note: four personality axes, $6F-$72, from MonsterTable bytes 22-25

73.note: 27 resistance levels: copied from species bytes $12-$2C when a record is created (CreateMonsterRecordOfKindTemp1_Sub01_LoadMonsterRecord), rolled for a child by RollChildResistancesToWCB43 and refreshed by RefreshRecordResistancesFromSpecies (E-0114, E-0127)

8E.note: name of the first parent (from its $01; CopyFourNamesByWCADDBit4Table) (C2 from E-0328: the child holds 'Vanyl', the base's name)

98.note: plus value of the first parent (from its $6D)

99.note: name of the second parent (C2 from E-0328: the child holds 'Moahm', the mate's name)

A3.note: plus value of the second parent

00.note: name, 10 bytes ($FF-filled by LoadMonsterAndSpeciesForListEntryC_ReadRecordBufferAndRecordBufferData for a wild monster) (C2 from E-0320: during that battle battler record 0 holds the same values as SRAM record 0 at $17 and $1B-$2C)

17.note: level (MonsterTable byte 9 for a wild monster) (C2 from E-0320: during that battle battler record 0 holds the same values as SRAM record 0 at $17 and $1B-$2C)

18.note: experience, 24 bits (MonsterTable bytes 6-7 and a zero high byte for a wild monster)

1B.note: HP word (MonsterTable base HP) (C2 from E-0320: during that battle battler record 0 holds the same values as SRAM record 0 at $17 and $1B-$2C)

1D.note: maximum HP word (GetBaseHP) (C2 from E-0320: during that battle battler record 0 holds the same values as SRAM record 0 at $17 and $1B-$2C)

1F.note: MP word (C2 from E-0320: during that battle battler record 0 holds the same values as SRAM record 0 at $17 and $1B-$2C)

21.note: maximum MP word (GetBaseMP) (C2 from E-0320: during that battle battler record 0 holds the same values as SRAM record 0 at $17 and $1B-$2C)

23.note: ATK word (GetBaseATK) (C2 from E-0320: during that battle battler record 0 holds the same values as SRAM record 0 at $17 and $1B-$2C)

25.note: DEF word (GetBaseDEF) (C2 from E-0320: during that battle battler record 0 holds the same values as SRAM record 0 at $17 and $1B-$2C)

27.note: AGL word (GetBaseAGL) (C2 from E-0320: during that battle battler record 0 holds the same values as SRAM record 0 at $17 and $1B-$2C)

29.note: INT word (GetBaseINT) (C2 from E-0320: during that battle battler record 0 holds the same values as SRAM record 0 at $17 and $1B-$2C)

2B.note: WLD word after INT (C2 from E-0320: during that battle battler record 0 holds the same values as SRAM record 0 at $17 and $1B-$2C; WLD 387 sits here as at the main record's $6B)

31.note: 27 resistance levels: RecomputeTargetStatsFromRecord packs them into the slot's 7-byte wSlotResistances record (LoadBattleArg0PointersThenRunPackResistanceFieldsToDE)

4D.note: MonsterTable byte 8 for a wild monster; copied to wFoeJoinClass1-3 for the three foes, 7 stops the defeated monster from joining

2D.note: personality bytes (MonsterTable bytes 22, 23, 25, 24 in that order)

01.note: sex-ratio class: 0 = always male, otherwise (byte & 3) indexes SexChanceByClass (10, 50, 90: the chance of female) in RollChildSexFromSpecies

02.note: bit 0 becomes bit 4 of the slot's wSlotBodyFlags at battle start (GameMode4_Init_Sub01); LegSweep and BigTrip skip or fail on such a target (ChooseTarget_LegSweep, ActionEffect_LegSweep)

03.note: bit 0 becomes bit 0 of the slot's wSlotBodyFlags: MetalCut multiplies damage by 50 against it (MultiplyDamageBy50IfSlotDamageFlagsBit0, ChooseTarget_MetalCut); a non-zero byte also raises a stat cap from 700 to 999 in battle kind 3

04.note: join-chance class 0-7: after a battle BattleEnd_Step5_Case00_WriteBattleFoeCountAndSpeciesIdLoEtc compares (random mod 200) with the chance table entry for it; 7 = never joins

05.note: values 0-3 in the 324 records but never read: every species read goes through wSpeciesRecord, and no code reads its byte 5 (the two whole-buffer users only clear it)

06.note: base level cap: copied to a new record's $57 (MON_MAX_LEVEL); BattleEnd_Step3 compares the level with it; ComputeBreedingChild starts the child's cap from it

08.note: three natural skills: copied to the first three entries of a new record's skill list $3C (MON_SKILL_LIST), the rest $FF

0B.note: field ability: string index in category $0D, which BeginStringDisplay_Bank08 redirects to bank $95's category 4, StringTable_FieldAbilities: None, Call ship, Call cloud, Smash rock, Burn, Cut, Open door; shown by ShowRecordSpeciesAndSkillNames and the record screens

0C.note: six stat growth rows, one per stat in the order of wLevelUpGains (bytes $0C-$11; C1: HP, MP, ATK, DEF, AGL, INT): ComputeLevelUpStatGainsForBattleArg1 passes each to ReadStatGrowthGain, and new and wild monsters pass each to StatFromGrowthRow

12.note: 27 base resistance levels: copied to a new record's $73-$8D (MON_RESISTANCES); LoadWD01AByteArg4 reads one

2D.note: base EXP word: GameMode4_Init_Sub01_Sub07 writes it as the low word of a new battler's 24-bit EXP (battler $18-$19), as MonsterTable bytes 6-7 do for wild monsters

01.note: 0: UpdateAndDrawSpriteSlots takes the sprite set from +2; otherwise another path

02.note: sprite id word: with OBJ_SET_MODE 0, bits 0-6 of the low byte are the set index, bit 7 selects DrawMetaSpriteSet_Bank26 and a non-zero high byte DrawMetaSpriteSet_Bank27; monster objects store the species word here (E-0300, E-0308)

09.note: animation counter: UpdateSpriteSlots type 0 increments it each frame unless +$D bit 1 is set (C1; E-0134 called it flags)

0D.note: flags (bit 1 stops the animation counter, bit 2 selects the frame rule)

0E.note: meta-sprite sub-index; bit 7 flips it horizontally (hSpriteAttrXor bit 5)

01.note: tile offset of the script meta-sprite (DrawFieldSprites)

02.note: sprite set index (bits 0-6); bit 7: a sub-index follows
